verdict.rationale: Kling's first-party llms.txt documents a RESTful API with JWT authentication (AccessKey + SecretKey), separate global and China API endpoints, and per-unit API pricing, and the homepage advertises MCP/CLI access so agents can drive Kling programmatically. A probe confirmed the llms.txt is live. Missing for 10: detailed API reference evidence (endpoint/operation listings, async task polling or callbacks, SDKs, rate limits) and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
